summaries.plain:
Billing-worker memory retention is fixed by removing obsolete `_last_batch` state; stress testing showed 7.3 MiB peak, 2.1 MiB retained, and zero pending events at 5,000 batches. All 118 tests passed (7 skipped), and documentation/security configuration gates were updated.

CLI billing filters are consolidated through `_add_billing_filters`, with typed currency handling, consistent help, and passing abbreviation and end-to-end tests. Ruff and diff checks were clean.

Webhook delivery now supports bounded retries with capped exponential backoff. Transport errors and retryable server responses are retried, while 4xx client errors fail immediately. All eight webhook tests and the full 44-test suite pass; formatting and whitespace checks are clean.

Search rebuild performance is being improved. Its test suite has two existing failures where rebuilt documents miss recently updated invoice descriptions. Profiling showed invoice scanning took 8.42 seconds, largely because invoices were embedded individually. The rebuilder now uses a bounded eight-worker helper to submit document batches concurrently while preserving order, reducing a 5,000-document run to 3.16 seconds. Rebuilder tests pass after updating the mocked embedding client for batch inputs. Profiling identified `EmbeddingClient.embed` as the largest remaining cost: 2.91 seconds across 125 calls. Next steps are to inspect batching/profile details, optimize further if warranted, and resolve the two indexing staleness failures.

Still pending elsewhere: update and force-push the ordered `get_user_record` → `fetch_account` rename; implement authenticated admin subscription pause/resume APIs; add payment-capture idempotency; then investigate invoice-counter concurrency.
